question: The scientific study of different aspects of plants is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**botany**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The scientific study of different aspects of plants is called **botany.**
 
• Botany is the scientific study of plants:
 
 
• how plants function,
 
• what they look like,
 
• how they are related to each other,
 
• where they grow,
 
• how people make use of plants, and
 
• how plants evolved.
